description: Live check of business signal sources (RFC-0023 phases 2 and 4). Releases livecheck:signal to the check endpoint, which acts on nothing, only with a signed approval for the target and only when the registered source livecheck-erp answers, signed, that the invoice named in the request is paid. Parmana asks the source; the agent's value is never used.

outcome.reason: Approved for this target, and the source says the invoice is paid.
Needs a signed approval for this target, and the source saying the invoice is paid.
